Linear projection over the final input dimension.

Maps input features to a configurable output width. Add a separate activation node when nonlinear behavior is required.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [ML Layers](../categories/ml-layers.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | dense, linear, fc |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Input features [batch, in_features]. Flatten higher-rank inputs first. |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Linear projection [batch, units]. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Layer | Output Units | `units` | Integer | `64` | `1-1048576` | The run | Number of output features. Required. |
| Fine-tuning | Frozen | `frozen` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Keeps this layer's weights as they are while the rest of the model trains: no gradient step, no weight decay, no optimizer memory. Use it on layers that start from a weights file (fine-tuning), then turn it off to train them too. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Usage

```text
Connect after any layer that outputs a 1D tensor, or after Flatten for 2D+ inputs.
```

## Tips

- For image classification, use after Flatten layer.
- Last Dense should match number of classes for classification.
